title: 1815 Prairie's stoop stands open on a pier and an arch
items: The front steps of the Sears-Meeker house at 1815 Prairie Avenue were a solid block of stone. The old side-on photograph shows them open underneath on the south side: the landing rests on a square stone pier at its corner with a dark space under it back to the house, and the flight springs off that pier on a curved arch that comes down to the ground partway along the steps. The stoop is now built that way. The basement door in that space, and the iron hand rail on the cheek, are still to come.
